description: Put several products into a basket in one step, across one or more Israeli businesses on AgentFeed. Pass the ids that search_products / browse_products / get_product returned, with quantities. Returns, per shop, a link that loads the items into that shop's own cart (or, for a business that takes orders by message, its order page with the list), the subtotal from the shop's published prices, and what is not known (shipping is set at the shop's checkout). Use it once the shopper has agreed to the items. Never ask for card details: the shopper pays on the shop's own site.

id.description: The product id from a search result, e.g. "judaicail:50343141605733".

name: build_cart
